requirements.statement: Deliver Wave 1 correctness, security, and source-of-truth units.
Resolve queue and upload topology before implementing durable successors.
Deliver deterministic performance changes before optional tuning.
Resolve evidence-gated performance and consistency decisions with decisive receipts.
Complete behavior-preserving maintainability work after shared behavior stabilizes.
Close conditional product directions through their named owner and trigger without speculative implementation.

criteria.test_rationale: PLAN_ONLY package; Wave 1 completion uses current-source, GitNexus, scoped static evidence, and user-authorized tests only when separately requested.
PLAN_ONLY package; queue and upload units require topology and state-machine evidence before code, while hosted proof remains separately authorized.
PLAN_ONLY package; deterministic performance units use source, statement-count, static, and bounded measurement evidence unless a test task is requested.
PLAN_ONLY package; evidence units may finish by implementing the supported branch or recording a decisive rejection without product-test execution.
PLAN_ONLY package; refactors require GitNexus and static contract evidence, with characterization suites retained as TEST_PROPOSAL until explicitly authorized.
PLAN_ONLY package; conditional directions close through current owner/trigger evidence and do not authorize browser rollout or product expansion.
Local scanner topology and provider-contract work is runnable; external provisioning, paid services, credentials, hosted proof, and deployment require separate user authority.
Publication queue contract and current binding review are runnable; a new or unbound queue/provider, paid service, deployment, or hosted mutation requires separate user authority.
Source and documentation review remain runnable, but test-file edits, automated product tests, browser automation, and CSP browser proof require an explicit current-task user request.

authorization_boundaries.boundary: External scanner provisioning, paid services, credentials, hosted proof, deployment, and unbound provider changes remain outside local plan execution.
A new or unbound publication queue/provider, paid service, deployment, or hosted mutation requires explicit user authority; current bound-resource contract review remains local.
Test-file edits, automated product tests, browser automation, screenshots, visual QA, and CSP browser proof require an explicit current-task user request.

transition_contract.rule: Apply exactly one allowed outcome for the receipt unit, resolve every mutation through state_precedence and idempotency, apply the resulting transitions atomically, then evaluate readiness_rules.

required_evidence: refreshed artifact, evidence, and manifest hashes
